stage_a_standalone_statement_draft: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a surjective flat morphism of schemes. If $X$ is reduced (each local ring of $X$ has no nonzero nilpotent element), then $Y$ is reduced. No finiteness assumption on $f$ is required.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves descent of reducedness along an arbitrary surjective flat map X→Y from reduced X, with no finiteness or smoothness requirement added.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a surjective flat morphism of schemes. If $X$ is reduced (each local ring of $X$ has no nonzero nilpotent element), then $Y$ is reduced. No finiteness assumption on $f$ is required.
hypotheses: f:X→Y is flat and surjective and X reduced.
